correctness.rationale: For any input, exactly one symbol is removed at each original run boundary, and a subsequence has no more transitions than its source, implying |y|+t(y)<=n. Any admissible y has an explicit input obtained by duplicating the first letter of each noninitial output run and appending deletable singleton runs up to length n. This proves both inclusions for every q>=2, n>=1. Injectivity of a deterministic map on a maximal code makes the optimum the cardinality of its image. Counting q-ary words by change sites proves the finite sum and generating function; a positive dominant root of u_s=u_{s-1}+(q-1)u_{s-2} proves the limit. Exhaustive direct image comparisons are reproduced for q=2,n<=14; q=3,n<=9; q=4,n<=7; q=5,n<=6, without substituting finite evidence for proof.

An exact iff output-range criterion yields constructive canonical preimages, every finite-length optimal zero-error code size, and precise capacity uniformly for all alphabets q>=2, including DNA alphabet q=4.
